CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

December 12, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: November 28, 2023

Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted the
minutes of the November 28, 2023 regular meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:
  • Board Member Daninger moved to approve all consent items.
  • The second was by Vice Chairman Hernandez.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  614 South Date Avenue

  •  This is an application for a new 8-foot-high wrought iron fence and three (3)
  wrought iron rolling gates for an existing commercial parking lot.
  •  Applicant: Nicolle Santillanes
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS- The proposed project is
  approved with conditions of approval.

  1
   •  Discussion: The applicant noted that the property has been previously vandalized
  and disturbed by homelessness. Daninger states that the 3rd rails are more of a
  design atheistic approach to the fence. Hernandez asked where staff was
  requesting the 3rd horizontal rail to located, if in the center or at the top portion.
  Staff’s response is that a condition would be to add a 3rd horizontal rail to the top
  for another layer of aesthetics to the fence design. The applicant is ok with this
  suggestion from staff. Board member Ng asks if the submitted plans were missing
  numbers or was there a file issue with downloading the document. Staff responses
  there were uploading issues and therefore some numbers were not transferred
  correctly.

MOTION:

  •  Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall work with City Architect to provide an additional
  horizontal rail to add articulation to the fence and provide a height dimension for
  each horizontal rail; 2) Identify the fence picket and post top style, in collaboration
  with the City Architect; 3) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings
  for the City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 3:  1303, 1325, and 1345 West Main Street

  •  This is an application for a new 19,771 SF 2-story full-service auto dealership with
  surface and roof deck parking on site.
  •  Applicant: Enrique Rodriguez and Bryan Mac Dermott
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: The applicant presented their project design to the board members.
  Secretary Kuchenski asks to clarify if the proposed stucco is not a smooth stucco
  but rather a sand texture stucco. The applicant replies yes. Board member Ng is
  asking if there is any exterior lighting on the building. The applicant responses
  there are two overlooking the car park and the rest are security lights. Daninger
  asks if there are any light poles visible from the upper parking lot. The applicant
  state yes, there are two light poles 25 feet away from the edge of the building at
  16 feet high. Board member Tsai asks what the perimeter fence or wall height on
  the north property line is. Staff response there is an existing 6-foot-high CMU wall
  with a portion of 6-foot-high chain link fence. Ng asks if other dealerships have
  used the catclaw vines in other locations because they grow severely. The
  applicant response no, they have not used these catclaw vines before.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  2
   Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 4:  1303, 1325, and 1345 West Main Street

  •  This is an application for five (5) new wall mounted signs and one (1) monument
  sign on a newly proposed 2-story full-service auto dealership.
  •  Applicant: Kasey Clark
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the conditions of approval.
  •  Discussion: Vice Chair Hernandez asks if the signage size is standard for the
  corporations. The applicant response yes, the signage size is a standard size for
  the Mazda dealership as well as the height for each sign. Kuchenski asks if the
  chrome callout material is not reflected but rather satin. The applicant agrees.

MOTION:

  •  Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1) The applicant shall provide specific color and material, finish, and illumination
  descriptions for the proposed monument sign; and 2) The applicant shall resubmit
  a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 5:  126, 132, and 146 South Palm Avenue; 127 South Raymond Avenue;
  and 2018 Teagarden Lane

  •  This is an application for the new construction of a 3,181 SF 1-story commercial
  restaurant building known as Raising Cane’s located within a single parcel,
  separate from the other two (2) new restaurants on the same site.
  •  Applicant: Jennifer Colicchio
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Chairman Udani notes that the handicap stall on the south side is
  narrow than the standard. The applicant states the ADA stall complies with the
  code for dimensions. Board member Tsai asks if perforated materials are a
  corporate standard. The applicant response yes, this is a corporate standard.
  Udani asks if the artwork on the walls is conceptual or what is proposed. The
  applicant states yes, what is shown today is the proposed artwork for the project.
  Vice Chair Hernandez asked if there is a wall proposed in-between Raising Canes
  and Panda Express. The applicant response there is not wall proposed in-between
  the building only landscaping because this is a cohesive site plan project.
  Hernandez asks if the canopies are utilized for shading the outdoor seating. The
  applicant states yes, there is a shading structure for outdoor dining as well as
  lighting and fans.

  3
 MOTION:

  •  Board Member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 6:  126, 132, and 146 South Palm Avenue; 127 South Raymond Avenue;
  and 2018 Teagarden Lane

  •  This is an application for the new construction of a 2,700 SF 1-story commercial
  restaurant building known as Panda Express located within a single parcel,
  separate from the other two (2) new restaurants on the same site.
  •  Applicant: Jennifer Colicchio
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: The applicant presented their project design to the board members.
  Chairman Udani ask how the applicant intends to drain the curved roof element on
  the building. The applicant response the curved element is only 10 inches deep
  and there will be built-in drainage hidden within the building. The other canopies
  are open metal trellis to provide shade. Vice Chair Hernandez ask if the circular
  element at the doors is embedded in the window. The applicant states the circular
  element on the storefront is embedded and part of it is a shaded structure. Tsai
  asks if the curved element is metal or wood structure. The applicant responses
  that the curved element is prefabricated metal that is attached to the building face
  and parapet.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 7:  126, 132, and 146 South Palm Avenue; 127 South Raymond Avenue;
  and 2018 Teagarden Lane

  •  This is an application for the new construction of a 1,172 SF 1-story commercial
  restaurant building known as Starbucks located within a single parcel, separate
  from the other two (2) new restaurants on the same site.
  •  Applicant: Jennifer Colicchio
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: The applicant presented their project design to the board members.
  Chairman Udani asks the applicant if a traffic study has been done for the three
  sites on this project. The applicant responses yes, there have been two studies

  4
   with the traffic engineer to ensure acceptance. Daninger asked if considerations
  were made due to the nearby Costco traffic. The applicant responses yes. Udani
  asks where the accessible paths from the public sidewalk are and from the parking
  lot. The applicant states there are stripped ADA paths on the parking lot and guard
  rails to protect pedestrians. Tsai notes the street facing the side of the building
  does not show any wood materials. The applicant notes that the street facing side
  is not the main entry point but rather the south side and drive-thru. Tsai states all
  elevations of the building should be treated with the same level of detail. The
  applicant notes there is a high-quality material of stone along this façade which
  gives this level of detail and aesthetic. Tsai notes the applicant should ensure the
  landscaping adds to the building façade in terms of species selection. Vice Chair
  Hernandez asks if there is a Starbuck logo on the street side as well, rather than
  just the parking lot sign. The applicant states that a free-standing sign is part of the
  separate sign program submittal. Board Member Ng asks if there is more
  wayfinding signage along the street facing side. The applicant states that there is
  ample landscaping and wayfinding to ensure the patron knows where to enter the
  business.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on January 9, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 10:00 P.M.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Eric Martinez
Secretary
